result.instructions: Tools for Hiboutik, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What was the turnover of my shop yesterday, and how many sales were closed?"; "Which products are low on stock in my main warehouse?"; "Find the customer with email marie@example.com and list her latest sales.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Hiboutik data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run hiboutik_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run hiboutik_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run hiboutik_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. hiboutik_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_stores
tools.title: List stores
tools.description: List the shops (stores) of the account: id, name, warehouse id, currency, time zone, address. Use store ids for sales, payment types and reports. GET /stores.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_warehouses
tools.title: List warehouses
tools.description: List warehouses (stock locations) with id and name. Use the ids for stock levels. GET /warehouses.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_users
tools.title: List users (vendors)
tools.description: List the Hiboutik users (staff, sales vendors): id, name, email, access level. The id is the vendor_id of a sale. Passwords and keys are never returned. GET /users.

tools.name: hiboutik_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a customer in Hiboutik. Needs at least a last name, first name, company or email. Returns the new customer id. POST /customers/.

tools.name: hiboutik_update_customer
tools.title: Update a customer attribute
tools.description: WRITE: change ONE attribute of a customer (it overwrites the current value). Attributes: gender (0 unknown, 1 male, 2 female), last_name, first_name, email, company, phone, vat, country, date_of_birth, customers_code, comments, validity, customers_ref_ext, customers_misc. PUT /customer/{customers_id}/.

new_value.description: The new value (for gender: 0, 1 or 2; for dates: yyyy-mm-dd). An empty string clears the attribute.

tools.name: hiboutik_set_sale_comment
tools.title: Set sale comment
tools.description: WRITE: add or replace the comment of a sale (it overwrites any existing comment). POST /sales/comments/.
